snippet.title: Get Moving with Bluey 🤩💙
snippet.description:
Get moving with Bluey and her family in Bluey: Bust-a-Move, available now on Nex Playground with Play Pass. Jump right into some of your favorite episodes, like Keepy Uppy, Musical Statues, and Fancy Restaurant. Are you ready for more imaginative, active play? Give it a go today! #nexplayground #playthatmovesyou #bluey

Don’t miss out—subscribe for updates and exclusive gameplay previews.
